CardMaker recreation of the original text of [[Rescue In The Clouds (V)]] (Virtual Set 9, released 6 July 2018). Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text has been found (no copy of the 2018 release slip survives; the earliest archived Set-9.pdf, 25 January 2021, is cut off and unreadable).

Text source: PC card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/3e5a4c7d/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json, commit 3e5a4c7d] (2 March 2021, before the March 2021 errata): “USED: Peek at the top 3 cards of your Reserve Deck and take one into hand; reshuffle. OR Cancel a just drawn destiny targeting the ability or defense value of your non-Undercover character of ability &lt; 5 at a system or mobile location. LOST: Cancel Close Call.”

Everything else (frame, art, title, icons, set mark, margin name) follows the PC's own card; no errata mark, since this is the original. Render: swccg.com/cardmaker (spec from <code>/api/card/209_22</code> with this game text, errata mark removed), 12 November 2026.
